<document id="products-checks">
Checkbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆpaperˆcheckbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆorˆmoneyˆorders.ˆ##ˆPayingˆsomeoneˆwhoˆneedsˆaˆcheckˆOptionsˆincludeˆBrookPayˆ(ifˆthey'reˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember),ˆanˆACHˆtransferˆtoˆtheirˆbankˆaccount,ˆorˆaˆwire.ˆManyˆlandlordsˆacceptˆACH.ˆ##ˆDepositingˆchecksˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆyouˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Depositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆapp".ˆ##ˆMoneyˆordersˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆcan'tˆbeˆdepositedˆthroughˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆClosingˆbalanceˆchecksˆTheˆonlyˆtimeˆweˆmailˆaˆcheckˆisˆwhenˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆaˆlinkedˆexternalˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆtheˆremainingˆbalanceˆbyˆcheck.ˆ##ˆDirectˆdepositˆformsˆthatˆaskˆforˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆUseˆtheˆpre-filledˆdirectˆdepositˆformˆinˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆItˆhasˆeverythingˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆwouldˆshow.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="close-statements">
StatementsˆafterˆclosingˆAfterˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount,ˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆinˆandˆdownloadˆstatementsˆforˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆDownloadˆthemˆbeforeˆyouˆgoˆWeˆrecommendˆdownloadingˆanyˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆyouˆmightˆneedˆbeforeˆyouˆclose.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments.ˆ##ˆAfterˆthatˆOnceˆtheˆdownloadˆperiodˆends,ˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen,ˆorˆemailˆus,ˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆtheˆstatementsˆyouˆneed.ˆWeˆkeepˆrecordsˆforˆsevenˆyears.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆinˆtheˆyearˆyouˆclosed,ˆweˆstillˆsendˆyourˆ1099-INTˆbyˆJanuaryˆ31.ˆ##ˆVerificationˆlettersˆAccountˆverificationˆlettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆ##ˆCardˆandˆtransactionˆhistoryˆYourˆstatementsˆlistˆeveryˆtransaction,ˆfee,ˆinterestˆpaymentˆandˆdisputeˆcreditˆforˆtheˆmonth,ˆsoˆthey'reˆusuallyˆallˆyouˆneedˆforˆrecords,ˆtaxesˆorˆaˆloanˆapplicationˆelsewhere.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="atm-cash-not-dispensed">
ATMˆdidn'tˆgiveˆmeˆmyˆcashˆIfˆanˆATMˆtookˆmoneyˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆbutˆdidn'tˆgiveˆyouˆtheˆcash,ˆorˆgaveˆyouˆlessˆthanˆyouˆaskedˆfor,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆNoteˆtheˆATMˆlocation,ˆdateˆandˆtime,ˆandˆkeepˆanyˆreceipt.ˆ2.ˆCheckˆtheˆapp.ˆSometimesˆtheˆATMˆreversesˆtheˆwithdrawalˆonˆitsˆownˆwithinˆaˆfewˆdays,ˆandˆtheˆtransactionˆdisappearsˆorˆshowsˆaˆmatchingˆcredit.ˆ3.ˆIfˆit'sˆstillˆthereˆonceˆtheˆwithdrawalˆhasˆposted,ˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆinˆtheˆappˆwithinˆ60ˆdays.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆCashˆnotˆdispensed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆWeˆaskˆtheˆATMˆoperatorˆforˆitsˆrecords.ˆMostˆATMˆcasesˆareˆresolvedˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆtheˆrecordsˆshowˆtheˆcashˆwasn'tˆdispensed,ˆweˆcreditˆtheˆfullˆamount,ˆincludingˆanyˆATMˆfeeˆweˆchargedˆforˆthatˆwithdrawal.ˆ##ˆPendingˆwithdrawalsˆYouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆaˆwithdrawalˆwhileˆit'sˆstillˆpending.ˆWaitˆuntilˆitˆposts.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
